AppHeader.title: Read Books Anywhere
AppHeader.subtitle: Your Entire Library in One App.
AppHeader.description: NovelGlide is a EPUB reader, offering a clean and immersive reading experience.

FeatureSection.title: Features
FeatureSection.customFeatDescription: You can adjust font size and line-height, turn on / off the dark mode, and the pagination. Create your own reading environment.
FeatureSection.cloudFeatDescription: You can back up your books, bookmarks, and collections to your personal cloud drive. Also, you can easily restore your backups from your cloud drive.
FeatureSection.exploreFeatDescription: NovelGlide support reading the catalog in Open Publication Distribution System (OPDS) format. You can download books from an OPDS server to your bookshelf.
FeatureSection.collectionDescription: Create your own collections to categorize books and arrange them in any order you want.
FeatureSection.bookmarkDescription: You can manually save your place with a bookmark or let the app automatically save it for you, so you can always jump back to where you left off.
